name: Navbar
description: The top bar of an app, with the brand, main links and actions.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo and name, at the start.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, search or the account menu, at the end.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Default "Main".

a11y: A <header> with a named <nav>; the current link has aria-current="page".
The current link is marked by weight and an indicator, not color alone.
